43:62.text: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

43:63.text: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom
and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.

43:64.text: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."

43:65.text: But the denominations from among them differed
, so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.

43:66.text: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?

43:67.text: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
